title: Grusch and the legacy reverse-engineering program

tellings.quote: So, then you have this idea of like what David Grusch may or may not have bumped into this like this legacy program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about what a whistleblower named David Grusch may or may not have stumbled upon: a long-running secret programme, which Grusch's supporters call a legacy programme, said to study recovered craft and try to copy their technology. If it exists, it would mean such technology has been held and studied out of public view for decades.
